mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede negative equity market returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a structural shift in consumer spending patterns toward services, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 0.5% growth and RSAFS < -0.5% growth in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST grows >0.5% and RSAFS falls >0.5% in 1 month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economic regime (INDPRO below its 12-month moving average), a further decline in industrial production signals worsening supply chain disruptions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 12-month MA, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) exceeding 600,000 units per month indicates robust residential demand, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 600,000, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, which typically triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicate an overheating labor market, which typically triggers monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer spending recovery regime (RSAFS above its 3-month moving average), a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when RSAFS > 3-month MA, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.
